title: Mapping class group action on the cohomology of the $\mathrm{SL}_n$ character variety
summary: We describe the mapping class group action on the cohomology of the twisted $\mathrm{SL}_n$-character variety of a surface $Σ_g$ of genus $g$. Our main tool is a relative version of the endoscopic decomposition of Maulik-Shen; this allows us to reduce the problem to the mapping class group action on the cohomology of a canonical finite cover of $Σ_g$, which was studied by Looijenga.
